title: 需要重画的电路：短接线
statement: 图示网络中，R_1 = 3 Ω，R_2 = 6 Ω，R_3 = 6 Ω 画成一排，但下方的导线把端子 a 和 R_2、R_3 之间的点连在一起，上方的导线把 R_1、R_2 之间的点和端子 b 连在一起。
先找出各电阻两端分别是哪个结点，再求 R_ab。

questions.ask: R_1、R_2、R_3 三个电阻的连接关系是？
choices: 三者都接在 a、b 之间，互相并联
R_1 与 R_3 串联后再与 R_2 并联
R_2 被短路，R_1 与 R_3 并联
choiceExplain: 串联要求首尾相接、中间结点不接别的东西；这里每个电阻的两端都直接接在 a 和 b 上。
顺着导线看 R_1 的右端：它经上方导线到 b，不是接到 R_3 上，所以 R_1、R_3 不是串联。
R_2 的两端分别是 b 和 a，不是同一个结点，所以没有被短路。
questions.explain: R_1：左端是 a，右端经上方导线接到 b；R_2：左端是 b，右端经下方导线接到 a；R_3：左端是 a，右端是 b。三个电阻都跨接在 a、b 之间，所以是并联。

hints: 用导线直接相连的点是同一个结点。给每个结点起名（a 或 b），把它写在每个电阻的两端。
如果每个电阻的两端都是 a 和 b，它们就是并联。
solution: **1. 标结点。** 端子 a 与下方导线、R_2 和 R_3 之间的点是同一结点 a；R_1 和 R_2 之间的点经上方导线与端子 b 是同一结点 b。
**2. 看每个电阻。** R_1：a–b；R_2：b–a；R_3：a–b。三个电阻都跨在 a、b 之间——**并联**。
**3. 重画。** 把 a、b 画成两条竖线，三个电阻并排连在中间。

en.title: Redrawing a circuit with shorting wires
statement: In the network, R_1 = 3 Ω, R_2 = 6 Ω and R_3 = 6 Ω are drawn in a row, but the lower wire joins terminal a to the point between R_2 and R_3, and the upper wire joins the point between R_1 and R_2 to terminal b.
First find which node each resistor end is on, then find R_ab.

questions.ask: How are R_1, R_2 and R_3 connected?
choices: All three are connected between a and b, i.e. in parallel
R_1 in series with R_3, then in parallel with R_2
R_2 is shorted; R_1 is in parallel with R_3
choiceExplain: Series needs end-to-end connection with nothing else at the middle node; here each resistor's two ends go straight to a and b.
Follow the wire from R_1's right end: it reaches b via the top wire, not R_3, so R_1 and R_3 are not in series.
R_2's two ends are b and a, not one node, so it is not shorted.
questions.explain: R_1: left end a, right end tied to b by the upper wire; R_2: left end b, right end tied to a by the lower wire; R_3: left end a, right end b. All three span a and b, so they are in parallel.

hints: Points joined by a plain wire are the same node. Name every node (a or b) and write the names at both ends of each resistor.
If every resistor has a and b at its two ends, they are all in parallel.
solution: **1. Label the nodes.** Terminal a, the lower wire and the point between R_2 and R_3 form node a; the point between R_1 and R_2 and terminal b (joined by the upper wire) form node b.
**2. Each resistor.** R_1: a–b; R_2: b–a; R_3: a–b. All three span a and b — they are **in parallel**.
**3. Redraw.** Draw a and b as two vertical rails with the three resistors side by side between them.
